name: McKesson
description: McKesson is one of the three big US drug wholesalers, along with Cencora and Cardinal Health. It buys medicines from manufacturers and delivers them to pharmacies, hospitals and clinics, earning a thin margin (segment operating profit was about 1.8 percent of FY2026 revenue of $403.4 billion). The profit mix is much better than the revenue mix suggests: oncology distribution and services for cancer clinics, technology that helps drug makers run patient-access programs, and a medical-surgical supply business earn more per dollar than pharmacy wholesale. Customer concentration is high: CVS was about 24 percent of revenue in FY2026 (partnership extended to June 2027), and the next two customers were 11 percent and 10 percent. It plans to separate the Medical-Surgical Solutions segment into an independent company.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label recorded from general knowledge of the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source. SEC SIC code is 5122 (Wholesale-Drugs, Proprietaries & Druggists' Sundries), from the EDGAR submissions record.

hq.note: 6555 State Hwy 161, Irving, TX 75039 (FY2026 10-K cover); Delaware corporation

employees.note: More than 43,000 employees worldwide, including 1,400 part-time (FY2026 10-K); the 10-K text also cites approximately 38,000 for a sub-group not identified in the extract

businessLines.name: North American Pharmaceutical
businessLines.how: Buys drugs from manufacturers and resells to pharmacies with a small markup (about 1 cent per dollar of sales) plus fees; profit rises with volume and with generic drug sourcing, so revenue is mostly pass-through drug cost.
businessLines.description: Distribution of branded, generic and specialty drugs to US and Canadian pharmacies and providers, plus generic sourcing.

revenue.note: FY2025 304,507 (+11%); growth from higher volumes at retail national account customers

businessLines.revenueNote: FY2025 304,507 (+11%); growth from higher volumes at retail national account customers

operatingProfit.note: vs $2,945M in FY2025; share is of total segment operating profit $7,379M (revenue less other segment expense)

businessLines.name: Oncology & Multispecialty
businessLines.how: Sells expensive specialty and cancer drugs to physician practices with a markup, and earns fees for managing practice operations, group purchasing and data services; drug price and volume drive revenue.
businessLines.description: Distribution and services for oncology and other specialty practices (US Oncology Network, specialty drugs).

businessLines.name: Prescription Technology Solutions
businessLines.how: Per-transaction and service fees paid by drug manufacturers for running access programs and by pharmacies for software; high margin because it is technology, not product resale.
businessLines.description: Technology for drug makers, pharmacies and payers: patient-access and affordability programs, prior-authorization and data services.

operatingProfit.note: vs $875M in FY2025. Small in revenue but 14 percent of profit

businessLines.name: Medical-Surgical Solutions
businessLines.how: Wholesale sale of consumable medical supplies, repeat-ordered by clinics, at a markup that is higher than drug wholesale.
businessLines.description: Supplies and equipment to physician offices, surgery centers and extended-care facilities.

operatingProfit.note: vs $779M in FY2025 and $955M in FY2024

businessLines.how: Not a core business; composition not extracted.
businessLines.description: Corporate-related items reported as Other, including equity-method earnings.
